KotOR: War|user=JohnJacksonMiller|date=2011-10-13|time=11:13 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210121111049/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/more-zayne-carrick-kotor-war.31941103/#post-31941167}}}} '''''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: War''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries from [[Dark Horse Comics]] written by [[John Jackson Miller]]. Set shortly after the [[Knights of the Old Republic 50|final issue]] of Miller's previous [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] series, ''War'' follows [[Zayne Carrick]] as he gets drafted into the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The [[Knights of the Old Republic: War 1|first issue]] was released on [[January 11]], [[2012]].
